describes: Hymn 499 'He Leadeth Me' under PILGRIMAGE & PERSEVERANCE, photographed off a computer screen -- so it carries glare and the resolution of the monitor rather than the page. Chords are printed above the staff and use stacked slash notation, the chord over its bass note as a fraction: G7 over C, C over G, G over F, C over E, F over C. Three verses plus a refrain.
